name.description: The name that the agent shows in the history and in comments.

ownership.description: `personal` makes an agent that you own, and it gets a token. `workspace` makes an agent that nobody owns, and it gets no token. Only an admin can make a workspace agent.

scopes.description: What the agent can do. If you do not send it, the agent gets `read` and `write`. The server refuses an unknown value.

items.description: `read` reads the board. `write` files, updates, comments and closes. `delete` removes records.
items.title: AgentScope
